component.name: bpmn-desk
component.summary: Create, edit and save BPMN diagrams

description.p: bpmn-desk is a desktop application for creating and editing BPMN (Business Process Model and Notation) diagrams. It embeds the Apache KIE standalone BPMN editor and adds native file open/save dialogs, an unsaved-changes guard, and standard keyboard shortcuts.

ul.li: Full BPMN 2.0 editing canvas powered by the Apache KIE BPMN editor
Open and save .bpmn files with native file dialogs
Unsaved-changes indicator and save prompt on close
Keyboard shortcuts for New, Open, Save and Save As

screenshot.caption: The BPMN editor with an open diagram

description.p: Initial Flathub release: Apache KIE BPMN editor in a desktop app with file open/save, dirty-state tracking and application icon.
